claim: In cdc_system.transmute_jobs (101_create_transmute_jobs.sql) and cdc_system.transform_jobs (100_create_transform_jobs.sql), the status column is VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' with no CHECK constraint, and StuckJobReaper.reapOnce preserves 'PAUSED' while also healing rows where cancel_requested = true AND status = 'FAILED' AND error_message LIKE 'reaper:%' to 'CANCELLED'.
evidence:

	_ = r.db.WithContext(ctx).Exec(`
		UPDATE cdc_system.transmute_jobs
		   SET status = CASE
		           WHEN cancel_requested = true THEN 'CANCELLED'
		           WHEN COALESCE(error_message, '') LIKE '%[auto-resume #3]%' THEN 'FAILED'
		           ELSE 'PAUSED'
		       END,
		       error_message = CASE
		           WHEN cancel_requested = true THEN 'cancelled by user'
		           WHEN COALESCE(error_message, '') LIKE '%[auto-resume #3]%' THEN COALESCE(error_message, '') || ' | reaper: max auto-resume attempts (3) exceeded'
		           WHEN COALESCE(error_message, '') = '' THEN 'reaper: heartbeat timeout (paused for worker auto-resume)'
		           ELSE error_message
		       END,
		       finished_at = CASE
		           WHEN cancel_requested = true OR COALESCE(error_message, '') LIKE '%[auto-resume #3]%' THEN NOW()
		           ELSE NULL
		       END,
		       updated_at = NOW()
		 WHERE (status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes')
		    OR (cancel_requested = true AND status = 'FAILED' AND error_message LIKE 'reaper:%')
	`).Error
